status: Independent undergraduate-level retrospective research prototype; not a medical device

datasets.eda_clima: CDC Peru Observatorio de Clima y Salud province-week export 2018-2025
datasets.eda_age: CDC Peru dashboard annual age-group summaries, user-provided images/table
datasets.dengue: MINSA individual dengue reporting CSV historical 2000-2025, aggregated to province-week
datasets.territory: CENEPRED 2026 physical hazard scenarios; RENIPRESS 2026; INEI projections

known_issues: Historical EDA age5+ 2024 national CSV incomplete
Dengue notification absence not proof of zero incidence
2026 CENEPRED/RENIPRESS not contemporaneous with historic outcomes
Exploratory EDA evaluation does not establish superiority over persistence; evaluation years were inspected during development.
